rVenue.name: GTS SECURITIES LLC
rVenue.materialAspects: RBCM routes orders to market centers, such as exchanges and alternative trading systems, that may provide rebates or charge execution fees depending on whether routed orders provide liquidity, or take liquidity from, such market center. In some cases, RBCM may receive rebates from a market center that exceed the amount of fees charged by such market center. Certain market centers may provide volume-based tiered pricing/payment schedules pursuant to which RBCM may receive incremental pricing benefits based upon the aggregate trading volume routed to the market center (including trading volume not associated with customer orders), in accordance with that market center’s published fee schedule.

Certain market centers may provide volume-based tiered pricing/payment schedules pursuant to which RBCM may receive incremental pricing benefits based upon the aggregate trading volume routed to the market center (including trading volume not associated with customer orders), in accordance with that market center’s published fee schedule.
